title: The Constant in HATE: Analyzing Toxicity in Reddit across Topics and Languages
findings: Contrary to some prior research, the study found that discussions related to the topic of religion do not have high levels of toxicity in their analysis, especially when compared to more toxic topics like Politics or Activism.
